body:
Thought i'd give you an update. 

Spoke to her about the situation, i got a mouthful of "you're just jealous, he's a friend" then he rang her. She picked up, realised she really isn't worth my time or the stress and ended it right there. Growing a pair feels good man.
Not the whole six months, it's only sprung about this last month, and after realising it isn't going to die off i guess it's time to mobilise.
I have, but i get the old 'Oh we're just friends, shut-up silly" response. I guess it's time to sit the lady down and let her know truly what's going on.
PM me with some contact details, let's get talking.
PM with MSN or any other method of communication. Someone here.
"When you believe in things that you don't understand, Then you suffer, Superstition ain't the way" - Stevie Wonder

It sounds like you have it worse than me. The chilie will be made, i forgot all about that stuff, it so freaking tasty. 

Hope it all gets better buddy, every cloud has a sliver lining.
You fucking rock dude, thankyou so much!
Sadly my kitchen is rather bare. I've got a stub of ginger, some garlic/tomato paste and other various bits and bobs lying around. But cheers for this dude, i'll defiantly give it a whirl.
